statements.t: Supported by our year-to-date results and visibility into fourth quarter demand, we are narrowing our full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $593 to $603 million and raising our adjusted EPS guidance to $3.22 to $3.32, representing 9% to 11% adjusted EBITDA growth and 14% to 18% adjusted EPS growth for the year,” said Joe Di Salvo, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
We expect to end 2026 with net debt to adjusted EBITDA leverage ratio of 2.2x to 2.3x.
Going forward, I expect we will take a balanced approach to deploying excess cash for further debt reduction and opportunistic share repurchases," said Mr.
I expect to continue to build on the momentum we have created this year, while accelerating our mission to materialize a brighter future.”
